connector.name: Cortex RMCP
connector.registryDescription: Rust MCP server for homelab logs, syslog, Docker logs, FTS search, and AI transcript correlation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cortex-rmcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.dinglebear. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CORTEX_HOME
env.description: Optional Cortex home directory containing configuration and local SQLite data.

env.name: CORTEX_TOKEN
env.description: Optional bearer token for Cortex MCP HTTP mode; also used by some shared configs.

env.name: CORTEX_API_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token for Cortex REST API routes when running daemon/API mode.

env.name: CORTEX_RMCP_VERSION
env.description: Optional GitHub release tag override for the downloaded Cortex binary.

env.name: CORTEX_RMCP_REPO
env.description: Optional GitHub owner/repo override for release asset downloads.

env.name: CORTEX_RMCP_RELEASE_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional release download base URL override.
